title: Update application
noneAvailable: No updates available. Click to check again.
updateNotification: New update available. Click to update.
checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Click to try again.
noRelease: No release has been published in this repository yet.
upToDate: You are using the latest version.
experimental: Test version: it may have bugs. To receive stable versions only, turn it off in Settings → Tools.
noPackage: This release has no package compatible with your computer.
manualInstall: After downloading, open the DEB or RPM package in your system installer. For AppImage, launch the downloaded file.
confirmPackage: The downloaded package will be installed in /opt/PeliGames and the launcher will restart. Linux may ask for your administrator password to authorize installation. Do you want to continue?
confirmAppImage: The current AppImage will be replaced with the downloaded version and the launcher will restart. Do you want to continue?
applying: Applying update… Authorize installation in the system dialog if requested.
pkexecFailed: Could not obtain system authorization. You can open the downloaded package to install it manually.
authCancelled: Authorization was cancelled. No new attempt will be made until you click again.
packageInstallFailed: The package manager could not complete installation. Check dependencies, your connection, and whether another installation is running.
restartFailed: The package was installed, but the launcher could not restart. Close and reopen the application.
network: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
rateLimit: GitHub has limited requests. Try again later.
invalidRelease: The published version needs a tag such as v0.8.0.
checksumMissing: This package has no SHA-256 digest provided by GitHub. Upload it again to enable verified downloading.
checksum: The downloaded file failed the integrity check. Try downloading again.
apply: Could not replace or launch the AppImage. Check folder permissions or use the downloaded file.
download: Could not save or open the package in the update cache. Details below identify the folder and the error.
